summary: Build an original short-drama score pack of 8 to 15 instrumental beds for tension, romance, comedy, and tearjerker scenes. Use it as a short drama soundtrack for short-drama BGM, vertical drama music, episode score, romance beds, tension beds, and original short-drama music.
